title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP11c — split profile authority layout bridge
goal: Allow generic V3 commands to consume physically separated profile authorities through one strict layout manifest before moving IFX policy files.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate, Docs and Architecture accept exactly one of the legacy profile directory or an explicit schema-valid layout manifest.
Explicit layout paths are repository-relative, remain below TargetRoot, exist, are distinct, and never fall back to legacy locations.
The generic tool suite proves directory/layout parity and retains generated gate, detector, architecture review and Markdown drift behavior.
No IFX authority, workflow, required check or active production caller moves in this bridge.
The trusted-base and policy/config authorizations are consumed exactly once in the protected change.
